★Request
Fade to black

Oooohhh!!
That's right, that's right! A race with us, Taishin!!
—I see. If only you were willing, all would be settled.

Indeed. While the opinions raised earlier came mainly
from the academy's faculty and training staff—
Therefore—I look forward to the mock race, Taishin.
...Is that pity? What, are you gonna go easy on me or something?

So passionate!! This Trainer is so fiery!!
Taishin, this person has gotta be a genuinely good person, I know ittttt!!
......*sigh* And?
Hmm. However, this emergency is far more serious than I had heard.

W-What's with that?
After getting yelled at like that yesterday, what are you...

Remarkable sharpness.
Tremendous explosive power.
Hayahide?! Not you too...!

Narita Taishin—an Umamusume who possessed a captivating late spurt despite her small build,
and above all, an intense thirst for victory.

As Narita Taishin tore down the track, there was no sign of impatience on her face.
Though positioned toward the back, she ran with steady composure.
T-Ticket, you... Were you eavesdropping on us?!

Even if it was in pursuit of improvement, coupled with repeatedly breaking curfew and school rules—
it was pointed out that your recent results have been poor and your physical condition concerning.
W-Who would want to team up with someone so overbearing—
Seeing Narita Taishin's bewilderment, I explained that I had watched footage of her past races.

The pace had unfolded at a slow tempo. In such cases, front-runners can preserve
their stamina until the very end, usually giving the leaders the advantage, but—

We should gather people for a mock race, Taishin.
We shall participate as well.
—Please, overturn this bad reputation with everything you have, Narita Taishin.
A scout?!

Her second half—especially her final three furlongs—
was astonishingly fast compared to other races at the same distance!

So, so, are you gonna accept the scout?!
Are you gonna sign the contract?!?!?
So annoying... You'll call literally anyone a "good person"...
Well...... about that......

Not at all. ...Heh, at any rate, there is one Umamusume right here
who wouldn't even know the meaning of holding back.
Ugh...

Whoa, there's a way?! That's our Hayahideee!!
What is it, what should we do?!

Right now, perhaps due to frustration, she burns through stamina fighting for early position,
leaving her unable to execute her closing drive in the final stretch. But—

Ah!! It's the Trainer who was with Taishin last night!!
Does this mean, could it possibly be—

When I looked into her, I found video footage
of a race she ran prior to enrolling...

Running like a demon consumed by sheer determination,
Narita Taishin had seized victory—!

Uwaaaahhhhh!!
You can't get expelled, Taishiiin!!
P-P-President?!
Cooperation...?

If we are to ignite expectations regarding your potential—your value in races—
then naturally, the only fitting stage is a race itself.
Narita Taishin had utterly shattered that conventional wisdom.
...Aaaarrrrggghhh!!
That's literally what eavesdropping is...
Nuh-uh! I was just straining my ears with everything I had!!
Why are you the one so fired up...

I-I-I-I'm—
SO TOOOOOOUCHEEEDDD!!!!!!
Huh—

I have been defending you, but frankly, I find myself completely surrounded.
...Therefore, I would like to request your cooperation.
The most effective way to overturn it is to demonstrate your power and potential.

...The reason we brought this up is quite simple.
Yet, simple truths are often the hardest to explain in words.
...You're the one from yesterday.

Pardon the intrusion. However, this is an urgent matter.
Could you come with me, Narita Taishin?

—Now then. That being said, to achieve the objective the President set before us,
there is only one path available to take.
...Every last one of them.
Haa, haa, haa...

I hurriedly flipped through the enclosed documents to check the times.
Since it was a slow-paced race, the first half was naturally on the slower side, but—

To put it plainly—
voices calling for your expulsion have been growing increasingly louder.

The moment that thought crossed my mind, I couldn't sit still any longer,
and before I knew it, I had rushed over to Narita Taishin.
(Overturn my bad reputation... What am I supposed to do out of nowhere—)
